verdict.rationale: Pipedream documents per-app MCP servers and an automatic `mcpClient.tools()` call that loads all available tools for a given server, and exposes a machine-readable app catalog via llms.txt/app-slug markdown pages (e.g. clickup.md) that lists thousands of integrations — giving some programmatic discoverability. However there's no evidence of a single documented registry/catalog API endpoint returning structured metadata across all servers/tools for agent-driven discovery beyond the standard MCP tools/list per connected app. Missing for 10: a dedicated catalog/registry API spec (params, response schema) and independent corroboration of agents querying it programmatically.
